planning_notes: Board is Arduino Uno with authoritative wiring on A0, D13, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6; all explicitly mentioned wired pins are represented by matching catalog interface_requests.
Button D3 is treated as active-high in the model (i.e., model value true when pressed); active_low handling is not applied because no active-low requirement was provided.

Vibration sensor D2 is configured as a digital input; if the vibration sensor is actually analog or requires different thresholding, that behavior is handled in SysML rather than by changing port kind.
Water level sensor A0 is configured as an analog input with scale=1 and offset=0; any conversion to a physical water level is handled in SysML.
tm1637_number is used with leading_zero=false; exact digit multiplexing/encoding is managed by the catalog driver.

Serial output for wash fault is represented via a single numeric fault-code report guarded by a boolean trigger; fixed-message serial_text_output was not used because the provided requirements only state 'serial output wash fault' without a required fixed literal string.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: User button confirmation for end-stage buzzer/LED stop

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED indicator (stage/status; flash during end until confirmation)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Buzzer output (sound during end-stage until confirmation)

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Display washing stage number: 1=进水, 2=洗涤, 3=甩干, 4=结束

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Vibration sensor signal (used to detect motion/wash cycle progress)

interfaces.name: io_5
interfaces.meaning: Water level sensor reading (used to detect water abnormal/appropriate levels)

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: When vibration is absent for a long time AND water level is abnormal, report wash fault

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个智能洗衣流程监控系统，使用振动传感器 D2、水位传感器 A0、蜂鸣器 D6、LED D13、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D3。系统根据振动和水位判断洗衣机处于进水、洗涤、甩干和结束四个阶段，并在数码管显示阶段编号；当检测到结束阶段时蜂鸣器鸣叫并闪烁 LED，直到用户按键确认。若长时间无振动且水位异常，则串口输出 wash fault。
